decisions.reason: Outpatient sociotherapy sits close to the core psychiatric offer and is now featured on the home page, which signals results meeting aspirations and gives no trigger for problemistic search.
Senior living counseling has been on the home page in both years, costs little to run, and feeds clients into the core eldercare business, so it clearly meets aspiration levels.
The retail shop has moved up to the home page and serves as a sales channel for the sheltered workshop, so it appears to perform adequately even though the related carpentry offer was dropped.
Meal delivery is new and its results are still uncertain, but it fits the eldercare core, and the firm's broad network gives enough slack to carry it while it is evaluated against aspirations.
